Cav On 04.05.2023 Pronounced On 19.05.2023

1 . The instant transfer petition has been filed under Section 407 of Cr.P.C. for transfer of Piparwar
P.S. Case No.33 of 2020 (G.R. No. 10 of 2021) registered under Section 323, 307, 498A, 504, 506,
406, 34 of Ipc and Sections 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act from the court of S.D.J.M., Chatra to the
civil court of competent jurisdiction at Daltonganj.
2.
The petition has been filed by the petitioner on the ground that the accused is threatening her to withdraw and compromise the present criminal case.
The opposite parties had abused and assaulted the petitioner and ousted her from her matrimonial house.
3. It is submitted that the petitioner is helpless lady and she has no any other source of income and she is not able to go to the civil court at Chatra and contest the case each and every date.
Her parents are old and ailing and poor persons and the petitioner cannot leave them for attending the court at Chatra.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the opposite party has opposed the transfer petition and submitted that he has not interfered with fair trial and no pressure has been brought upon the prosecutrix for withdrawal of the case.
Having considered the rival submission, grounds taken and the materials on record, the transfer petition is allowed.

Accordingly, Piparwar P.S. Case No.33 of 2020 (G.R. No. 10 of 2021) registered under Section 323,
307, 498A, 504, 506, 406, 34 of IPC and Sections 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act is transferred from the court of S.D.J.M., Chatra to the court of competent jurisdiction at Daltonganj for hearing and final disposal.

(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.)
Jharkhand High Court, Ranchi Dated the 19th May, 2023 NAFR / AKT Neha Kumari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169436665/
